items.name: Metro 2025 State Championship Tees
items.description:
Celebrate Metro’s incredible season with the official 2025 Missouri Class 3 State Championships tee or hoodie!
 This soft athletic-gray shirt proudly features the bold Metro Cross Country Panther logo on the front and the full state roster and coaching staff on the back — a keepsake for athletes, families, and supporters alike.
Perfect for everyday wear or cheering from the sidelines, this shirt honors the dedication, teamwork, and pride of the Metro Cross Country Team.
Available in youth and adult sizes.
 Limited quantities — order yours before they’re gone!

items.name: Parkway North Vikings Cross Country State Championship
items.description:
This exclusive Parkway North Cross Country State Championship shirt features the school’s signature purple and black colors with a strong, athletic design that celebrates the team’s hard work and success.
Perfect for athletes, families, and fans, this tee is soft, durable, and designed for all-day comfort — whether you’re running, cheering, or repping the Vikings spirit around town.
Available in youth and adult sizes.
 Show your school pride and celebrate the Vikings’ journey to State!
